cases.scenario: System stays responsive with many users browsing at once
cases.tool: Node.js load script (100 virtual users, Playwright request contexts)
cases.target: 100 concurrent users, error rate < 1%, 95% of API requests ≤ 1 s
cases.condition: Single-server Docker deployment as on the test server
cases.actual: 100 virtual users, 60 s, 9,134 requests: error rate 0.00%, p95 173 ms, p50 148 ms, max 581 ms (partial: one workstation, reads only; condition not met: not the Docker deployment, writes not covered)
cases.reason: Condition not met: measured on single workstation (reads only), not the single-server Docker deployment.
cases.aiNote: Partial pass: one workstation, not the Docker server; reads only. Condition not met: one Windows workstation ran the app, PostgreSQL, Redis and the load generator, not the single-server Docker deployment; reads only (meeting list, notifications, meeting details, /auth/me), each user every 0.5 s. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8 · Run by the QA runner on a local build of app 6baba24f.

cases.aiNote: The speech worker and the local language model do not run on the test machine. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Restored per review PR 507 (the target stays in Report 3 §IV.2.2 and targets are never adjusted to fit the app).
